blockers.consequence: An app built against the iOS 27 SDK without the scene lifecycle does not launch. Apps already shipped, and apps still built against the iOS 26 SDK, keep working.
blockers.title: No UIScene lifecycle

blockers.consequence: UIRequiresFullScreen=true opts the app out of a resizable scene, so the layout this score measures never gets the canvas.
blockers.title: Opted out of resizable presentation

findings.message: UIScreen.main.bounds is a fixed geometry read; use the view's own bounds or the window scene.
Root navigation that cannot become a sidebar: the panes will not split when the scene is wide.
Layout branching on device idiom or interface orientation; a resizable scene is described by its size class.
Hardcoded frame larger than a control: it will not reflow when the scene changes width.
Scroll or selection state is not preserved; a scene resize can rebuild the hierarchy and lose it.
